title: Sprint 3 — Task CRUD Operations & User Isolation
description: Implement task creation, listing, and single retrieval while enforcing strict per-user data ownership.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Create New Task API
tickets.description:
Implement `POST /api/tasks` allowing an authenticated user to create a task.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Request Body
```json
{
  "title": "Complete Java Spring Boot Lab",
  "description": "Finish all 4 sprints with passing tests"
}
```

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with Spring Security authentication (extract current `User`).
2. Validate that `title` is non-empty. Return `400 Bad Request` if title is missing.
3. Create new `Task` entity associated with `currentUser`.
4. Persist task to database and return `201 Created` with `{"message": "Task created successfully", "task": {...}}`.
learning_objectives: Associate created JPA entities with authenticated users.
Implement payload validation for required fields in Spring Boot.
Return proper HTTP 201 Created responses with serialized entity maps.

tasks.title: Validate non-empty title in request payload.
Persist task to database with `user_id` set to current user.

common_mistakes: Allowing the client to pass arbitrary `user_id` in the request body instead of taking it from the JWT authentication.
Allowing empty string titles to be saved.
hints: Extract current user from `Authentication` using `(User) authentication.getPrincipal()`.
Instantiate `new Task(currentUser, title, description)` and call `taskRepository.save(task)`.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - List Authenticated User Tasks
tickets.description:
Implement `GET /api/tasks` returning all tasks belonging to the authenticated user.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with Spring Security authentication.
2. Query only tasks where `user.id == currentUser.getId()` ordered by creation date descending.
3. Return `200 OK` with JSON `{"tasks": [...]}` containing an array of serialized task objects.
learning_objectives: Filter JPA repository queries by authenticated user identifier.
Serialize collections of Spring Boot entities into JSON arrays.
Ensure data isolation between multiple users.

tasks.title: Return JSON list of tasks with HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Querying all tasks (`taskRepository.findAll()`) instead of filtering by `userId`.
Returning un-serialized entity objects causing lazy-loading / circular reference errors.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Retrieve Task by ID with Ownership Authorization
tickets.description:
Implement `GET /api/tasks/{id}` to retrieve the details of a specific task.

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with Spring Security authentication.
2. Find task by `id`. If no task exists or if it belongs to another user, return `404 Not Found` with `{"error": "Task not found"}`.
3. If the task belongs to `currentUser`, return `200 OK` with `{"task": task.toDict()}`.
learning_objectives: Enforce horizontal authorization / access control checks.

tasks.title: Retrieve task by primary key from URL parameter.
Return HTTP 404 on missing or unauthorized task access.

common_mistakes: Returning tasks of other users without checking `userId` (IDOR security flaw).
Throwing unhandled NoSuchElementException when non-existent IDs are queried.
hints: Query using `taskRepository.findByIdAndUserId(id, currentUser.getId())` for atomic lookup and authorization.
